# Hearth & Honey Bakery

> Small-batch home bakery in Draper, Utah, run by owner and baker Megan Jackman. Known for hand-rolled cinnamon rolls made to order. Orders are placed by email (orders@hearthhoneybakery.com) or Instagram DM (@hearth.honey.bakery) and handed over at a public meet-up spot around Draper. No shipping, no online checkout, no prices published online.

Key facts:
- Business name: Hearth & Honey Bakery (also written "Hearth and Honey")
- Owner and baker: Megan Jackman
- Location: Draper, Utah 84020, United States (home bakery; city only)
- Order by email: orders@hearthhoneybakery.com
- Order by Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/hearth.honey.bakery/
- Fulfillment: meet-up handoff at a public place around Draper; at least 2 days' notice
- Legal: made in a home kitchen that is not licensed or inspected by the Utah Department of Agriculture and Food or a local health department (Utah Food Freedom Act)

## Menu

- [Cinnamon Rolls](https://hearthhoneybakery.com/menu/#cinnamon-rolls): soft dough rolled with brown sugar and cinnamon, baked golden, finished with a vanilla-cream glaze. Ingredients: flour, milk, brown sugar, heavy cream, butter, eggs, water, sugar, yeast, salt, vanilla, cinnamon. Contains wheat, milk, eggs.
